import copy,json; from work import evaluate
# supplied-argument behavior, missing conditions, verification, exact matching, conflicts, canonical JSON, supersession, false, immutability
def chk(got,want):
 assert got == want, (got,want)
r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}}; e=[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1},'verified':True}]; p={'required_conditions':['a'],'require_verified':True}

reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); rep=json.load(open('report.json')); assert rep == [evaluate(x,ev,pol) for x in reqs]; assert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in rep)
